name: The Islamic Association of Arabi
mission: The goal of the Islamic Association of Arabi is to provide convenient places of worship, islamic education and dawah. The IAA provides Islamic education where children, local and from afar, can learn and memorize the Quran and become scholars of deen.
theoryOfChange: By providing Islamic education and producing American-born scholars and Imams, the community will be better served and the true spirit of Islam conveyed.

strengths_deep_dive: The primary structural positive for the Islamic Association of Arabi is its financial program allocation. In FY2024, the charity directed <cite id="2">96.2% of its expenses into program services</cite>, exceeding the sector benchmark of 75% as well as the <cite id="9">peer median of 90.5%</cite>. Additionally, Charity Navigator reports <cite id="9">fundraising efficiency under <$0.01 per $1 raised</cite>, ensuring that public contributions go directly toward operating educational facilities like the Al-Hameed Boys Academy and local community operations.
rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Association of Arabi faces substantial operational limiting factors, primary among which is holding <cite id="9">38.8 months of working capital reserves</cite> despite accumulating zakat funds that require prompt distribution. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="2">total revenue of $3,110,855</cite> while operating the Al-Hameed Boys Academy, Amatur Rahman Girls Academy, and a local zakat ministry <cite id="1">serving fuqara and masakin</cite>. While the organization allocated <cite id="2">96.2% of expenditures to program expenses in FY2024</cite>, transparency remains low due to <cite id="9">undisclosed board governance structures</cite> and a lack of formal outcome evaluation. Furthermore, the organization earned an <cite id="9">overall score of 81.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting notable accountability and financial governance gaps.
